opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers based at UK universities or UK not‑for‑profit research organisations
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for interdisciplinary, curiosity‑driven research by established independent researchers

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers at any career stage based in the UK, with prior public engagement experience
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative public engagement projects in the humanities and social sciences

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in humanities or social sciences based at UK universities or research organisations, with a recent doctorate
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships to support independent research leading to a publishable piece

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers with a long‑term appointment at a UK HEI or independent research organisation, in the humanities or social sciences
opportunities.summary: Funding to develop and share new research skills and methods

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers in humanities or social sciences, with international partners; PI must be postdoctoral or above; overseas co‑applicants required
opportunities.summary: Funding for interdisciplinary projects on mobilities involving SHAPE and STEM disciplines

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑ and mid‑career UK researchers in humanities or social sciences
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships hosted at DGAP in Berlin to develop policy‑relevant research and networks

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months
opportunities.summary: Funding to support additional needs of applicants or award‑holders, such as equipment, caring costs, or assistance with application preparation
